name: Venom to the Undercity
summary: Apothecary Lydon is delighted with the venom taken from the Witherbark's spider god, and wants a sample sent to Lydon's superior, Faranell, at the Apothecarium in the Undercity. A parcel is entrusted to you for the journey.

sections.title: A Potent Find
sections.body: Lydon has killed nearly two dozen rabbits with a single dose of the venom. Some of them were tiny, so their resistance was surely low, but there is no denying the poison is powerful. Lydon is certain that Faranell will want to test it personally, and hands you a parcel to carry to the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

faq.q: Who is sending the parcel to the Undercity?
aliases: who gives venom to the undercity
quest giver venom to the undercity
who starts venom to the undercity
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon sends it, after testing the venom taken from the Witherbark's spider god.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the venom in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell, Lydon's superior, in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.

faq.q: How potent was the venom during testing?
faq.answer: A single dose was enough to kill nearly two dozen rabbits, though some were very young and tiny.

aliases: previous quest venom to the undercity
faq.answer: It follows Summoning Shadra, in which the venom was taken from the spider god.
